messages:
lucas: Quick note— we've had 3 postmortems last quarter with open action items past 60 days. Proposing a tight follow-up flow + a weekly remediation-oncall rota. Thoughts?

anika: +1. Main pain is ownership handoff after the IC steps down. We should require a remediation_owner and an ACK field.

omar: Agree. Minimal timeline idea:
```
0h: incident declared + IC assigned
24h: postmortem draft + candidate AIs
48h: remediation_owner assigned & ACKed
7d: mitigation plan posted
14d: PR/rollback created or exception approved
30d: verification + close
90d: recurrence review
```

lucas: SLAs: owner ACK <=48h, mitigation plan <=7d for P0/P1, PR or rollback <=14d. We'll allow exceptions with approval from oncall lead.

anika: For tracker schema (CSV):
```
incident_id,created_ts,severity,ai_id,summary,remediation_owner,owner_ack_ts,due_ts,status,verification,linked_prs,recurrence_count,notes
```

policy-bot: reminder: I can schedule follow-up pings. Use `/followup create <incident> 7d 30d` and I'll DM owner at 7d and 30d if status is still open. I will also post a channel summary on close.

paul: Suggest a fallback owner model: remediation_owner + fallback_remediation (weekly rota). If owner doesn't ACK in 48h, fallback gets auto-assigned. I'll run the rota for first month.

omar: Action items: paul add rota, anika add required fields to postmortem form, lucas add timeline template to playbooks, omar wire bot commands. ETA: 1 week for bot + form, 3 days for playbook template, pilot next two incidents.

anika: I'll add a short verification checklist field so closures include metrics/screenshots. Ping this thread when PRs are up.

lucas: Thanks team. If no pushback on SLAs, I'll open the PRs tomorrow and assign owners in the thread. :rocket:
